headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Kimberly-Clark (KMB) Mixed Q2 Results And New Hesperaloe Fiber Bet
summary: Kimberly-Clark reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$4,189 million versus US$4,163 million a year earlier, while net income fell to US$345 million from US$509 million, and also unveiled an alternative natural fiber program using the drought-resistant hesperaloe plant to support future sustainable hygiene products. An interesting angle is how Kimberly-Clark is pairing only modest sales growth and weaker quarterly earnings with a patented hesperaloe-based materials...
